children: An account with more than $370,000 in profits bought $117,000 worth of LGD to beat TES in Polymarket’s "LPL Third Stage Playoffs LGD vs. TES" prediction event, with an average entry price of 34.8 cents and 335,483 shares purchased. According to Odaily, the LGD vs. TES match began at 17:00 on August 29 and was played as a best-of-five series.

title: Polymarket Account Buys $117,000 in LGD to Beat TES Ahead of LPL Playoff Match
